title: How many sign restrictions are needed? A sharp lower bound for identifying multiple shocks in SVARs
title_primary: How many sign restrictions are needed? A sharp lower bound for identifying multiple shocks in SVARs
authors: Xuewen Yu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper derives the exact minimum number of impact sign restrictions required to identify shocks in a structural vector autoregression under a natural pairwise separation condition. The answer is . The proof follows from deriving a sharp lower bound using a Kraft-type inequality and then constructing an admissible restriction matrix that attains the bound. Our result reveals a significant sparsity gain: while traditional recursive orderings require restrictions, sign-based separation requires only , providing a transparent benchmark for designing sparse identifying schemes in large SVARs.

title: From planar proximity to room-level depth: Nonlinear capitalization of historic landscape visibility in dense urban districts
title_zh: 从平面邻近到街区尺度深度：密集城区历史景观可见性的非线性资本化
title_primary: 从平面邻近到街区尺度深度：密集城区历史景观可见性的非线性资本化
title_secondary: From planar proximity to room-level depth: Nonlinear capitalization of historic landscape visibility in dense urban districts
authors: Zuozheng Shi, Chenfan Cai, Wenlin Zhao, Jin Rui
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Historic landscapes are frequently capitalized into accommodation prices, yet existing valuation frameworks still rely heavily on planar proximity or coarse visibility proxies that fail to capture room-level three-dimensional exposure in dense urban settings. This study develops an automated multi scalar analytical framework that integrates room level three dimensional viewshed modelling, street-view image perception, semantic segmentation, and explainable machine learning to estimate how multidimensional visual exposure translates into hotel room premiums in Beijing’s historic core. The analysis yields four main findings. First, three-dimensional exposure variables, especially maximum visual depth, provide substantially greater explanatory power than conventional visible-area measures, showing that being spatially close is not equivalent to seeing deeply. Second, room premiums respond to visual environments through nonlinear thresholds rather than smooth linear increments: moderate vertical observation conditions and moderate visual complexity are associated with stronger capitalization, whereas excessive visual competition from surrounding buildings rapidly erodes marginal returns. Third, landmark visual connectivity corresponds to discrete rent surges once critical visibility levels are reached, indicating that iconic heritage nodes reflect threshold like spillover effects on nearby accommodation prices. Fourth, both the magnitude and internal structure of visual premiums vary sharply across districts, demonstrating that capitalization is spatially differentiated rather than spatially uniform within the historic core. By shifting valuation from planar proximity to room-level depth, this study advances three-dimensional visibility assessment and provides an operational framework for view-corridor protection, height control, and differentiated heritage-area management in high-density historic environments. abstract_zh: 历史景观常被资本化入住宿价格之中，然而现有的估值框架仍主要依赖平面邻近性或粗略的可见性代理指标，未能捕捉高密度城市环境中房间级别的三维暴露情况。本研究开发了一种自动化的多尺度分析框架，整合了房间级别的三维视域建模、街景图像感知、语义分割及可解释机器学习，以估算多维视觉暴露如何转化为北京历史核心区酒店房间的溢价。分析得出四项主要发现。第一，三维暴露变量，尤其是最大视觉深度，相比传统可见面积指标提供了显著更强的解释力，表明空间上的接近并不等同于视觉上的深入。第二，房间溢价对视觉环境的响应呈现非线性阈值特征，而非平滑线性递增：适度的垂直观察条件和适度的视觉复杂度与更强的资本化效应相关联，而周边建筑过度的视觉竞争则迅速侵蚀边际回报。第三，地标视觉连通性在达到关键可见度水平后对应离散的租金激增，表明标志性遗产节点对周边住宿价格产生类似阈值的溢出效应。第四，视觉溢价的幅度及内部结构在各区域间差异显著，证明在历史核心区内，资本化效应在空间上呈现差异化而非均匀分布。通过将估值从平面邻近性转向房间级别的深度，本研究推进了三维可见性评估，并为高密度历史环境中的视廊保护、高度控制及差异化遗产区管理提供了操作框架。

title: Search and Negotiation with Biased Beliefs in Consumer Credit Markets
title_zh: 消费者信贷市场中的有偏信念与搜索谈判
title_primary: 消费者信贷市场中的有偏信念与搜索谈判
title_secondary: Search and Negotiation with Biased Beliefs in Consumer Credit Markets
authors: Erik Berwart, Sean K. Higgins, Sheisha Kulkarni, Santiago Truffa
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How do biased beliefs about the interest rate distribution affect search, negotiation, and loan terms in consumer credit markets? In collaboration with Chile's financial regulator, we conducted a randomized controlled trial with 112,063 loan seekers. Randomly eliciting beliefs about interest rates led participants to search more and obtain lower rates. Most participants underestimated both interest rate levels and dispersion. Showing them a price comparison tool we built using administrative data on the universe of consumer loans caused them to update their beliefs, negotiate more, obtain lower rates without searching more, and be more likely to take out a loan.
abstract_zh: 关于利率分布的偏差信念如何影响消费信贷市场中的搜索、谈判及贷款条款？我们与智利金融监管机构合作，对112,063名贷款申请者进行了一项随机对照试验。随机引出对利率的信念促使参与者增加搜索并获取更低的利率。大多数参与者低估了利率水平和离散度。我们利用行政数据构建的价格比较工具，覆盖所有消费贷款，向参与者展示后，他们更新了信念，增加了谈判，无需更多搜索便获得了更低的利率，并且更有可能成功贷款。

title: Procompetitive effects of vertical mergers? Evidence from the European Union
title_zh: 纵向合并的促进竞争效应？来自欧盟的证据
title_primary: 纵向合并的促进竞争效应？来自欧盟的证据
title_secondary: Procompetitive effects of vertical mergers? Evidence from the European Union
authors: Chiara Bellucci, Armando Rungi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the relationship between mergers and firm-level financial measures using a sample of 4,482 acquisition targets in the European Union from 2007 to 2021. Findings suggest that horizontal mergers lack statistically significant results, whereas vertical mergers entail changes in markups (-0.7%), market share (+2.5%), Return on Fixed Assets (ROFA) (+2.3%), and capital intensity (-7.2%). The result for vertical mergers increases over time, and is larger when the number of pre-existing subsidiaries is greater. Our results suggest the elimination of double profit margins as a potential explanation.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2007年至2021年间欧盟4,482个收购目标样本，探讨了并购与企业层面财务指标之间的关系。研究发现，横向并购在统计上不显著，而纵向并购则涉及加成率（-0.7%）、市场份额（+2.5%）、固定资产回报率（ROFA）（+2.3%）和资本密集度（-7.2%）的变化。纵向并购的效果随时间增强，且在既有子公司数量较多时更为显著。我们的结果提示，消除双重利润边际可能是一个潜在的解释机制。

title: When Tariffs Disturb Global Supply Chains
title_zh: 关税扰乱全球供应链之时
title_primary: 关税扰乱全球供应链之时
title_secondary: When Tariffs Disturb Global Supply Chains
authors: Gene M. Grossman, Elhanan Helpman
official: 官方在线 2020-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study unanticipated tariffs on imports of intermediate goods in a setting with firm-to-firm supply relationships. Firms that produce differentiated products conduct costly searches for potential input suppliers and negotiate bilateral prices with those that pass a reservation level of match productivity. Global supply chains are formed in anticipation of free trade. Once they are in place, the home government surprises with an input tariff. This can lead to renegotiation with initial suppliers or new search for replacements. We identify circumstances in which renegotiation generates improvement or deterioration in the terms of trade. The welfare implications of a tariff are ambiguous in this second-best setting, but plausible parameter values suggest a welfare loss that rises rapidly at high tariff rates.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在具有企业间供应关系的环境中，对进口中间品征收意外关税的情况。生产差异化产品的企业会进行成本高昂的搜索以寻找潜在投入品供应商，并与那些通过匹配生产率保留水平的供应商进行双边价格谈判。全球供应链是在预期自由贸易的前提下形成的。一旦这些供应链建立起来，本国政府便意外地引入投入品关税。这可能导致与初始供应商重新谈判，或寻找新的替代供应商。我们识别了重新谈判导致贸易条件改善或恶化的情形。在这种次优环境中，关税的福利影响是不明确的，但合理的参数值表明，在高关税税率下，福利损失会迅速增加。

title: Centralized and competitive extraction of distributed renewable resources on networks with nonlinear aggregate growth
title_zh: 网络非线性总量增长下分布式可再生资源的集中与竞争性开采
title_primary: 网络非线性总量增长下分布式可再生资源的集中与竞争性开采
title_secondary: Centralized and competitive extraction of distributed renewable resources on networks with nonlinear aggregate growth
authors: Filippo de Feo, Giorgio Fabbri, Silvia Faggian, Giuseppe Freni
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-08-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the optimal and strategic extraction of a renewable resource that is spatially distributed over a network, migrates across nodes (with no loss of biomass during transit), and evolves according to a nonlinear (concave) aggregate growth function. A subset of nodes hosts extractors, while the remaining ones serve as reserves. We analyze a centralized planner's problem and a non-cooperative game with stationary Markov strategies. For three canonical growth families (logistic, power, and log-type saturating laws) paired with corresponding utilities, we derive closed-form value functions and feedback rules for the planner, and we construct a symmetric Markov equilibrium for the game on strongly connected networks.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一种可再生资源的最优与策略性开采问题，该资源在网络上空间分布，可在节点间迁移（迁移过程中生物量无损失），并依据非线性（凹形）总量增长函数演化。部分节点设有开采者，其余节点则作为保护区。我们分析了集中规划者的问题以及采用平稳马尔可夫策略的非合作博弈。针对三种典型增长族（逻辑斯蒂、幂函数和对数型饱和规律）及其对应的效用函数，我们为规划者推导出闭式价值函数和反馈规则，并在强连通网络上构建了博弈的对称马尔可夫均衡。

title: Fiscal Progressivity of the U.S. Federal and State Governments
title_zh: 美国联邦与州政府的财政累进性
title_primary: 美国联邦与州政府的财政累进性
title_secondary: Fiscal Progressivity of the U.S. Federal and State Governments
authors: Johannes Fleck, Jonathan Heathcote, Kjetil Storesletten, Giovanni Violante
official: 官方在线 2025-01-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper measures the progressivity of taxes and transfers at the U.S. federal level and separately for each state. The findings are as follows. (i) The federal tax and transfer system is progressive. (ii) State and local tax and transfer systems are close to proportional, on average. (iii) There is substantial heterogeneity in tax levels and tax progressivity across states. (iv) States that are funded mostly by sales and property taxes tend to have regressive tax systems and low average tax rates. States that are funded mostly by income taxes tend to have progressive tax systems and high average tax rates. (v) Regressive states are concentrated in the South and attract more inter-state net migration, especially of high-income migrants. (vi) State progressivity has remained broadly stable between 2005 and 2016. (vii) Incorporating corporate income and business taxes decreases average state progressivity but increases federal progressivity. (viii) Including spending on public goods and services as a transfer has a large positive impact on measured progressivity.
abstract_zh: 本文衡量了美国联邦层面及各个州分别的税收与转移支付的累进性。研究发现如下：（i）联邦税收与转移支付体系具有累进性。（ii）州及地方税收与转移支付体系平均而言接近比例性。（iii）各州在税收水平和税收累进性上存在显著差异。（iv）主要依赖销售税和财产税的州往往拥有累退性税收体系和较低的平均税率；而主要依赖所得税的州则倾向于拥有累进性税收体系和较高的平均税率。（v）累退性州集中在南部，并吸引了更多的跨州净迁移，尤其是高收入移民。（vi）2005年至2016年间，各州的累进性总体保持稳定。（vii）将公司所得税和营业税纳入考量后，平均州级累进性下降，但联邦累进性上升。（viii）将公共物品和服务的支出视为转移支付，对测得的累进性有显著的正面影响。

title: When political pressure trumps academic freedom
title_zh: 当政治压力凌驾于学术自由之上
title_primary: 当政治压力凌驾于学术自由之上
title_secondary: When political pressure trumps academic freedom
authors: Dominic Rohner, Oliver Vanden Eynde, Philine Widmer
official: 官方在线 2026-08-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Academic freedom has been declining over the past decade across the world. This column analyses over 25,000 economics working papers to show that, beyond direct intervention by authorities, political pressure also breeds self-censorship. After US federal agencies began screening research for a list of flagged words in early 2025, economists at universities most dependent on federal funding reduced politically sensitive content – even in research without any direct federal funding.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，全球学术自由持续下滑。本专栏分析了超过25,000篇经济学工作论文，揭示出除当局直接干预外，政治压力亦催生自我审查。自2025年初美国联邦机构开始对研究进行敏感词汇筛查以来，最依赖联邦资助的大学经济学家，即便在未获任何直接联邦资金支持的研究中，也减少了政治敏感内容。

title: Short Sale Bans May Improve Market Quality During Crises: New Evidence from the 2020 Covid Crash
title_zh: 危机期间卖空禁令或可提升市场质量：来自2020年新冠疫情崩盘的新证据
title_primary: 危机期间卖空禁令或可提升市场质量：来自2020年新冠疫情崩盘的新证据
title_secondary: Short Sale Bans May Improve Market Quality During Crises: New Evidence from the 2020 Covid Crash
authors: Caroline Fohlin, Zhikun Lu, Nan Zhou, Albert J. Menkveld, Knut Are Aastveit 等
official: 官方在线 2022-12-05 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper leverages cross-country policy variation during the 2020 Covid crisis to assess differential impacts of bans on stock liquidity, prices, and volatility. Results suggest that bans improved liquidity and stabilized prices for illiquid stocks but temporarily diminished liquidity for highly liquid stocks. The findings support theories in which short sale bans may improve liquidity by selectively filtering out informed—potentially predatory—traders. Thus, policies that target the most illiquid stocks may deliver better overall market quality than uniform short sale bans imposed on all stocks.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2020年新冠危机期间各国政策的差异性，评估了卖空禁令对股票流动性、价格及波动性的差异化影响。结果表明，禁令改善了流动性不佳股票的流动性并稳定了价格，但暂时降低了高流动性股票的流动性。研究结果支持了这样一种理论：卖空禁令通过选择性过滤掉知情——可能具有掠夺性——的交易者，从而可能提升流动性。因此，针对流动性最差股票的政策可能比对所有股票实施统一的卖空禁令更能提升整体市场质量。

title: Board Dynamics over the Startup Life Cycle
title_zh: 初创企业生命周期中的董事会动态
title_primary: 初创企业生命周期中的董事会动态
title_secondary: Board Dynamics over the Startup Life Cycle
authors: MICHAEL EWENS, NADYA MALENKO
official: 官方在线 2026-08-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We explore the dynamics of venture capital (VC)‐backed startup boards using novel data on director entry, exit, and characteristics. At formation, a typical board is entrepreneur‐controlled. Independent directors join the median board after the second financing and hold a tie‐breaking vote. Their presence is particularly likely when potential VC‐entrepreneur conflicts are larger. At later stages, control switches to VCs and independent director characteristics change. These patterns align with key financial contracting theories, but also highlight unique roles of independent directors over the life cycle: mediation followed by advising. Independent directors thus represent another potential source of value‐add to startup performance.
abstract_zh: 我们利用关于董事进入、退出及特征的新数据，探讨了风险投资支持的初创企业董事会的动态变化。成立之初，典型董事会由企业家控制。独立董事在第二轮融资后加入中位数董事会，并持有决定性投票权。当风险投资与企业家之间潜在冲突较大时，独立董事的出现尤为可能。在后期阶段，控制权转移至风险投资方，独立董事的特征也随之改变。这些模式与关键金融契约理论相符，但也凸显了独立董事在生命周期中的独特角色：先是调解，后是咨询。因此，独立董事构成了初创企业绩效增值的另一潜在来源。

title: Can Gifted Education Help Higher-Ability Boys from Disadvantaged Backgrounds?
title_zh: 天才教育能否帮助来自弱势背景的高能力男孩？
title_primary: 天才教育能否帮助来自弱势背景的高能力男孩？
title_secondary: Can Gifted Education Help Higher-Ability Boys from Disadvantaged Backgrounds?
authors: David Card, Eric Chyn, Laura Giuliano
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Boys are less likely than girls to enter college, a gap that is often attributed to a lack of non-cognitive skills such as motivation and self-discipline.We study how being classified as gifted -determined by having an IQ score of 116 or higher -affects college entry rates of disadvantaged children in a large urban school district.For boys with IQ's around the cutoff, gifted identification raises the college entry rate by 25-30 percentage points -enough to catch up with girls in the same IQ range.In contrast, we find small effects for girls.Looking at course-taking and grade outcomes in middle and high school, we find large effects of gifted status for boys that close most of the gaps with girls, but no detectable effects on standardized tests scores of either gender.Overall, we interpret the evidence as demonstrating that gifted services raise the non-cognitive skills of boys conditional on their cognitive skills, leading to gains in educational attainment.
abstract_zh: 男孩进入大学的比例低于女孩，这一差距常被归因于缺乏动机和自律等非认知技能。我们研究在一个大型城市学区中，被认定为资优——依据智商分数达到116或以上——如何影响弱势儿童的大学入学率。对于智商接近临界值的男孩，资优认定将大学入学率提高了25至30个百分点——足以赶上同智商范围内的女孩。相比之下，我们发现对女孩的影响较小。通过考察初中和高中的课程选择及成绩结果，我们发现资优身份对男孩有显著影响，缩小了与女孩之间的大部分差距，但对两性的标准化测试成绩均无可检测的影响。总体而言，我们将证据解读为表明，资优服务在认知技能不变的情况下提升了男孩的非认知技能，从而带来了教育成就上的收益。

title: The Price and Distributional Impact of Flood Risk Disclosure: Evidence from US Housing Platforms
title_zh: 洪水风险披露的价格与分配效应：来自美国住房平台的证据
title_primary: 洪水风险披露的价格与分配效应：来自美国住房平台的证据
title_secondary: The Price and Distributional Impact of Flood Risk Disclosure: Evidence from US Housing Platforms
authors: Stephen B. Billings, Sophie Calder-Wang, Weiling Liu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How does information disclosure reshape the allocation of environmental risk in the housing market? We quantify the price and distributional impact of the nationwide disclosure of property-level flood risk from First Street on U.S. housing platforms. Using a difference-in-RD design that exploits discrete cutoffs in the disclosed risk categories, we find that homes labeled as "extreme'' flood risk experience a 3.3% price discount and stay on the market for a week longer, relative to those labeled as "severe'' risk. These effects are strongest for coastal properties and remain pervasive across different FEMA floodplain designations. Disclosure also generates significant household resorting: buyers of extreme-risk homes have 5.3% lower income, are more likely to use FHA financing, and are older. Through a discrete choice model, we find that the redistribution of risk to lower-income households is primarily driven by price changes rather than heterogeneous preferences for flood risk.
abstract_zh: 信息披露如何重塑住房市场中环境风险的配置？我们量化了First Street在全国范围内披露房产级洪水风险对美国住房平台价格与分配效应的影响。利用披露风险类别中的离散阈值，采用断点回归设计，我们发现：相较于被标记为"严重"风险的房产，被标记为"极端"洪水风险的房产价格折价3.3%，且上市时间延长一周。这些效应在沿海房产中最为显著，并广泛存在于FEMA不同洪泛区划中。信息披露还引发了显著的家庭重新分层：极端风险房产的购买者收入低5.3%，更倾向于使用FHA融资，且年龄偏大。通过离散选择模型，我们发现风险向低收入家庭再分配的主要驱动力是价格变化，而非对洪水风险的异质性偏好。

title: DP771 A Model of UK Emigration, 1870-1913
title_secondary: DP771 A Model of UK Emigration, 1870-1913
authors: Tim Hatton
official: 官方在线 1993-04-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper develops a simple time-series model of emigration and applies it to data for emigration from the UK between 1870 and 1913. The model is derived from a microeconomic analysis of the migration decision and provides a specific functional form and dynamic structure. It encompasses many of the features of models used in earlier research in which the specifications have been essentially ad hoc. The results support the model strongly in most respects. Both wage rates and employment rates in the sending and the receiving countries influenced fluctuations in emigration. The short-run fluctuations were driven largely by variations in employment rates while the long-run level of emigration was determined largely by the relative wage.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个简洁的移民时间序列模型，并将其应用于1870年至1913年间英国移民数据的实证分析。该模型基于移民决策的微观经济学分析，提供了具体的函数形式与动态结构，涵盖了早期研究中诸多本质上具有临时性特征的模型规范。实证结果在多数维度上显著支持该模型：迁出地与迁入地的工资率与就业率共同影响移民波动。短期波动主要由就业率变化驱动，而长期移民水平则主要由相对工资水平决定。

title: DP810 Exchange Rate Regimes and Trade Prices: Does the EMS Matter?
title_zh: 汇率制度与贸易价格：欧洲货币体系是否重要？
title_primary: 汇率制度与贸易价格：欧洲货币体系是否重要？
title_secondary: DP810 Exchange Rate Regimes and Trade Prices: Does the EMS Matter?
authors: Andre Sapir, Khalid Sekkat, Max Posch, Itzchak Tzachi Raz
official: 官方在线 1993-08-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates the role of the exchange rate regime in the process of trade adjustment, by examining the relationship between trade prices and exchange rate regimes. The theoretical framework is a dynamic one à la Froot-Klemperer (1989). The empirical investigation takes advantage of the simultaneous occurrence, since 1979, of relatively stable exchange rates inside the ERM and instable rates outside to engage in a controlled experiment on the impact of the exchange rate regime on trade prices. The results suggest that a system of pegged rates like the EMS, although helpful, is not necessary to achieve a smooth process of trade adjustment. It appears that the absence of misalignment rather than the type of exchange rate regime is the crucial factor for fulfilling such an objective.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察贸易价格与汇率制度之间的关系，探究汇率制度在贸易调整过程中的作用。理论框架采用Froot-Klemperer（1989）的动态模型。实证研究利用1979年以来欧洲汇率机制（ERM）内部汇率相对稳定而外部汇率不稳定的同期现象，开展关于汇率制度对贸易价格影响的受控实验。结果表明，尽管欧洲货币体系（EMS）等钉住汇率制度有所助益，但并非实现平稳贸易调整过程的必要条件。实现该目标的关键因素似乎在于避免汇率失调，而非汇率制度类型本身。

title: Payday and the Monthly Attention Cycle of Low-Wage Workers
title_zh: 发薪日与低薪工人的月度注意力周期
title_primary: 发薪日与低薪工人的月度注意力周期
title_secondary: Payday and the Monthly Attention Cycle of Low-Wage Workers
authors: Claire Lelarge
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using linked survey and administrative wage records, we measure workers’ financial monitoring through the accuracy of their self-reported earnings. An unsupervised latent-class model distinguishes transitory reporting errors from rounding behavior and persistent reporting biases, allowing us to interpret lower reporting uncertainty as more precise knowledge of one’s wages. Among low-wage workers, reporting precision exhibits a pronounced pay-cycle pattern: it increases by approximately 12 percent in the days leading up to payday and declines immediately afterward. No comparable pattern emerges among higher-wage workers. These findings suggest that predictable liquidity constraints lead low-wage workers to monitor their personal finances more closely as payday approaches.
abstract_zh: 利用关联的调查数据与行政工资记录，我们通过工人自报收入的准确性来衡量其财务监控程度。采用无监督潜类别模型，将暂时性报告误差与四舍五入行为及持续性报告偏差区分开来，从而将较低的报告不确定性解释为对自身工资更精确的认知。在低收入工人群体中，报告精确性呈现出显著的薪酬周期模式：发薪日前数天精确性提升约12%，发薪日后立即下降。而高收入工人中未发现类似模式。这些发现表明，可预测的流动性约束导致低收入工人在发薪日临近时更密切地监控个人财务状况。

title: DP145 From Labour History to the History of Industrial Relations
title_zh: 从劳工史到劳资关系史
title_primary: 从劳工史到劳资关系史
title_secondary: DP145 From Labour History to the History of Industrial Relations
authors: Jonathan Zeitlin
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This article advances a new conception of labour history as the history of industrial relations, understood broadly as the changing relationships between workers, trade unions, employers and the state. The first half of the paper examines the major interpretative traditions in British labour history, from the Webbs and the 'Oxford School' to the postwar social historians and the 'rank-and-filists'. It shows that despite their many differences, both institutionalists and social historians explain the development of labour institutions by reference to the objective interests of social groups, and goes on to raise some theoretical objections to this form of explanation. The second half of the paper draws on the findings of recent research on the history of work and industrial relations in late nineteenth and twentieth century Britain to argue that relationships between workers and employers were shaped less by informal groups or spontaneous social and economical processes than by institutional forces: by organizations such as trade unions, shop stewards' committees, business enterprises, employers' associations and the state; and by the rules and procedures governing their interaction such as collective agreements, conciliation and arbitration boards, wages councils and legislati.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的劳工史概念，即将其视为劳资关系史，广义上理解为工人、工会、雇主与国家之间不断变化的关系。论文前半部分考察了英国劳工史的主要阐释传统，从韦伯夫妇与“牛津学派”到战后社会史学家及“基层活动派”。研究表明，尽管制度主义者与社会史学家存在诸多差异，但两者均通过参照社会群体的客观利益来解释劳工制度的发展，并进而对这种解释模式提出若干理论质疑。论文后半部分借鉴近期关于19世纪末至20世纪英国工作与劳资关系史的研究成果，论证工人与雇主之间的关系更多受到制度力量而非非正式群体或自发社会经济进程的影响：这些制度力量包括工会、车间代表委员会、企业、雇主协会及国家等组织，以及集体协议、调解与仲裁委员会、工资委员会及立法等规范其互动的规则与程序。

title: After Credit Suisse, markets find bail-in less credible
title_zh: 瑞信事件后，市场对内部纾困机制的信任度下降
title_primary: 瑞信事件后，市场对内部纾困机制的信任度下降
title_secondary: After Credit Suisse, markets find bail-in less credible
authors: Alessandro Di Stefano, Yvan Lengwiler, Kumar Rishabh
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: When Credit Suisse failed in March 2023, Swiss authorities, against market expectations, set aside the resolution plan and arranged a UBS takeover backed by public guarantees, sparing the bail-in bondholders who were next in line to absorb losses. This column traces how that choice reshaped investor beliefs about bail-in across Europe. Spreads on bail-in debt narrowed, the funding penalty on weaker banks shrank, and yields moved less on earnings news. Each points the same way: investors now see bail-in as less likely, a sign that its credibility has declined.
abstract_zh: 2023年3月瑞信倒闭时，瑞士当局违背市场预期，搁置处置计划并安排瑞银在公共担保支持下进行收购，使本应承担损失的保释债持有人得以幸免。本专栏追踪了这一选择如何重塑欧洲投资者对保释机制的信念。保释债利差收窄，弱势银行的融资惩罚缩小，收益率对盈利消息的反应减弱。这些现象均指向同一结论：投资者如今认为保释可能性降低，表明其可信度已然下降。

title: Does Increasing Financial Access to Contraception in the U.S. Reduce Unintended Pregnancies? Evidence from the M-CARES Randomized Control Trial at Two Years
title_zh: 美国增加避孕药具的经济可及性是否能减少意外怀孕？来自M-CARES两年随机对照试验的证据
title_primary: 美国增加避孕药具的经济可及性是否能减少意外怀孕？来自M-CARES两年随机对照试验的证据
title_secondary: Does Increasing Financial Access to Contraception in the U.S. Reduce Unintended Pregnancies? Evidence from the M-CARES Randomized Control Trial at Two Years
authors: Martha J. Bailey, Emilia Brito, Deniz Gorgulu, Kelsey Figone, Vanessa Wanner Lang 等
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use a randomized controlled trial to examine how out-of-pocket costs affect contraceptive method choice, pregnancy, abortion, and childbirth among uninsured U.S. women. The study recruited women seeking care through Title X—a national family planning program subsidizing reproductive health services for low-income Americans—and randomized vouchers, making the full spectrum of contraception highly discounted or free. We find that subsidizing contraception has large and persistent effects on the choice of con- traceptive method, resulting in significantly fewer pregnancies and abortions at 26 months. The effects on births are inconclusive.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，考察自付费用如何影响美国无保险女性的避孕方法选择、怀孕、堕胎及分娩。研究招募了通过Title X（一项为低收入美国人提供生殖健康服务补贴的国家计划生育项目）寻求医疗服务的女性，并随机发放代金券，使各类避孕措施大幅降价或免费。我们发现，补贴避孕措施对避孕方法的选择产生了显著且持续的影响，在26个月时导致怀孕和堕胎数量显著减少。对分娩的影响尚无定论。

title: Monetary Policy Transmission in Sub-Saharan Africa: Evidence from Emerging and Frontier Markets
title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的货币政策传导：来自新兴与前沿市场的证据
title_primary: 撒哈拉以南非洲的货币政策传导：来自新兴与前沿市场的证据
title_secondary: Monetary Policy Transmission in Sub-Saharan Africa: Evidence from Emerging and Frontier Markets
authors: Johanna Tiedemann & Olivier Bizimana & Kiswendsida Tougouma
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper empirically reassesses monetary policy transmission in emerging and frontier market economies in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA EFMs). Using the identification approach of Romer and Romer (2004), we construct measures of monetary policy shocks and provide evidence on transmission mechanisms in the region. We show that monetary policy shocks pass through quickly to short-term market interest rates and lead to persistent increases in bank deposit and lending rates in most economies, indicating an operative bank-based interest rate channel. By contrast, exchange rates generally do not appreciate and, in many cases, depreciate following monetary tightening, consistent with the exchange rate puzzle—suggesting that interest rate hikes alone may be insufficient to systematically influence exchange rate movements. We also find that contractionary monetary policy reduces both output and inflation, with effects that are modest and notably weaker than in more developed economies. In addition, we find that transmission is stronger in economies that have adopted, or are transitioning toward, inflation-targeting regimes. Finally, we show that cross-country heterogeneity in transmission largely reflects differences in monetary policy transparency, financial development, and, to a lesser extent, fiscal dominance.
abstract_zh: 本文对撒哈拉以南非洲新兴及前沿市场经济体（SSA EFMs）的货币政策传导机制进行了实证再评估。采用Romer与Romer（2004）的识别方法，我们构建了货币政策冲击的度量指标，并提供了该区域传导机制的证据。研究表明，货币政策冲击能迅速传导至短期市场利率，并在多数经济体中导致银行存款利率与贷款利率持续上升，表明银行主导的利率渠道具有有效性。相比之下，汇率在货币紧缩后通常不会升值，反而在多数情况下出现贬值，这与"汇率之谜"现象一致——暗示单纯加息可能不足以系统性影响汇率变动。我们还发现，紧缩性货币政策会同时降低产出与通胀，但其影响幅度温和且显著弱于发达经济体。此外，在已采用或正转向通胀目标制的经济体中，货币政策传导效应更强。最后，研究表明跨国传导异质性主要源于货币政策透明度、金融发展水平的差异，而财政主导地位的影响相对较小。

title: Estimating Interaction Effects With Panel Data
title_zh: 使用面板数据估计交互效应
title_primary: 使用面板数据估计交互效应
title_secondary: Estimating Interaction Effects With Panel Data
authors: Chris Muris, Konstantin M. Wacker
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper analyzes how interaction effects can be consistently estimated under economically plausible assumptions in linear panel models with a fixed ‐dimension. We advocate for a correlated interaction term effects (CITE) estimator and show that it is consistent under conditions that are not sufficient for consistency of the interaction term effect estimator that is most common in applied econometric work. Our paper discusses the empirical content of these conditions, shows that standard inference procedures can be applied to CITE, and analyzes consistency, relative efficiency, inference, and their finite sample properties in a simulation study. In an empirical application, we test whether labor displacement effects of robots are stronger in countries at higher income levels. The results are in line with our theoretical and simulation results and indicate that standard interaction term effect estimation underestimates the importance of a country's income level in the relationship between robots and employment and may prematurely reject a null hypothesis about interaction effects in the presence of misspecification.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了在固定维度的线性面板模型中，如何在经济上合理的假设下一致地估计交互效应。我们提倡使用相关交互项效应（CITE）估计量，并证明在应用计量经济学工作中最常见的交互项效应估计量的一致性条件不充分的情况下，CITE仍能保持一致。本文讨论了这些条件的实证内容，展示了标准推断程序可应用于CITE，并通过模拟研究分析了其一致性、相对效率、推断及有限样本性质。在实证应用中，我们检验了机器人对劳动力替代效应是否在高收入国家更为显著。结果与我们的理论和模拟结果相符，表明标准交互项效应估计低估了国家收入水平在机器人与就业关系中的重要性，并可能在存在设定误差时过早拒绝关于交互效应的原假设。

title: Cyclical behavior in large location games
title_zh: 大型区位博弈中的周期性行为
title_primary: 大型区位博弈中的周期性行为
title_secondary: Cyclical behavior in large location games
authors: Gary Charness, Daniel Friedman, Weinan Gong, Lones Smith
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Location games capture important economic phenomena ranging from preemption to choice of bank leverage. We explore a parametric family of location games with many players, each facing a conflict between maximizing a fundamental payoff component and a relative (or quantile dependent) component. Using simulations and human subject experiments we show that, behaviorally, the stationary Nash equilibria in such games are terrible predictions of behavior and payoffs when players can freely adjust their locations. Instead, large cycles consistently emerge, in which behavior slowly grows bolder over time. This corresponds to progressively earlier timing in pre-emption games or to increasingly later timing in wars of attrition. When locations are maximally bold, namely at the end of the domain of Nash play, behavior quickly reverts to the peak fundamental and a new cycle begins.
abstract_zh: 区位博弈捕捉了从抢占先机到银行杠杆选择等一系列重要经济现象。我们探讨了一个包含众多参与者的参数化区位博弈家族，其中每个参与者都面临在最大化基本面收益成分与相对（或分位数依赖）成分之间的冲突。通过模拟实验和人类受试者实验，我们表明，在行为层面，此类博弈中的静态纳什均衡在参与者能够自由调整其位置时，对行为和收益的预测能力极差。相反，大规模循环持续出现，其中行为随时间逐渐变得更加大胆。这对应于抢占博弈中时机逐渐提前，或消耗战中时机逐渐延后。当位置达到最大胆程度，即处于纳什博弈域的末端时，行为迅速回归至基本面峰值，新一轮循环随即开始。

title_secondary: Strategic materials and state capacity in Renaissance Italy: The economic policies of ‘Roman saltpetre’ procurement
authors: Fabrizio Antonio Ansani
official: 官方在线 2026-04-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Demonstrating the existence of a soaring demand for strategic materials in fifteenth‐century Rome, the article pioneers research in the late medieval trade in saltpetre, the irreplaceable, rare component of gunpowder, indispensable for waging war following the diffusion of artillery technology. More importantly, the essay highlights the political measures undertaken to support the supply of materiel, revealing a pragmatic stance that combined state control with private initiative. The result is a compelling example of the role arms procurement played in the early development of state capacity.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文通过论证十五世纪罗马对战略物资需求的急剧增长，开创了对中世纪晚期硝石贸易的研究。硝石作为火药中不可或缺且稀有的成分，在火炮技术传播后成为战争不可或缺之物。更重要的是，本文着重探讨了为保障物资供应所采取的政治措施，揭示了一种结合国家控制与私人主动性的务实立场。这一案例有力地展示了军备采购在国家能力早期发展中所扮演的角色。

title: Political Accountability and Local Government Debt: Evidence from China
title_zh: 政治问责与地方政府债务：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 政治问责与地方政府债务：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Political Accountability and Local Government Debt: Evidence from China
authors: Li, Runheng, Tang, Yao, Weng, Xi, Zhou, Li-An
official: 官方在线 2026-04-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study investigates how the interaction of political accountability and local officials' career incentives shapes the market for Municipal Corporate Bonds (MCBs) in China, taking the 2017 local government debt personal responsibility rule as a quasi-natural experiment. We develop a stylized incomplete-information bargaining model to analyze how the rule reshapes the bargaining equilibrium by rendering officials' observable characteristics credible signals of bailout incentives. Using a dataset of prefecture-level MCBs from 2008 to 2020, we empirically test the model's predictions and focus on separating officials' incentive effects from their inherent ability. Our core findings show that post-announcement of the rule, each additional year of a local party secretary's remaining time to retirement, a proxy for bailout incentives, reduces MCB spreads by approximately 2.5 basis points and increases issuance volume by about 2.0%. These effects are significantly amplified in fiscally stressed cities. Notably, under the 2017 rule, cities led by party secretaries with stronger bailout incentives can expand MCB issuance, which is contrary to the rule's original intent to rein in local borrowing.
abstract_zh: 本研究以2017年地方政府债务终身问责制为准自然实验，探究政治问责与地方官员职业激励的交互作用如何塑造中国市政企业债券市场。我们构建了一个简约的不完全信息讨价还价模型，分析该制度如何通过使官员可观测特征成为纾困激励的可信信号，重塑讨价还价均衡。基于2008-2020年地级市市政企业债券数据集，我们实证检验模型预测，并重点分离官员激励效应与内在能力差异。核心发现表明：该制度实施后，地方党委书记退休剩余年限（纾困激励代理变量）每增加一年，市政企业债券利差下降约2.5个基点，发行规模增长约2.0%。上述效应在财政压力较大的城市显著增强。值得注意的是，在2017年问责制下，由纾困激励更强的党委书记领导的城市反而能够扩大市政企业债券发行规模，这与该制度抑制地方举债的初始意图相悖。

title: Supply chain washing: Strategic disclosure of corporate suppliers
title_zh: 供应链洗白：企业供应商的战略性披露
title_primary: 供应链洗白：企业供应商的战略性披露
title_secondary: Supply chain washing: Strategic disclosure of corporate suppliers
authors: Yilin Shi, Jing Wu, Yu Zhang, Yuqing Zhou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates how firms manage supplier disclosures to project a greener supply chain. We show that firms selectively reveal relationships with high-ESG suppliers while withholding ties to low-ESG ones. A shift in the supplier’s environmental score from the 10th to the 90th percentile increases disclosure probability by 4.4% relative to the mean disclosure rate. Our analysis suggests this selective disclosure reflects greenwashing rather than genuine communication of supply-chain ESG improvements. In a U.S. subsample, firms are more likely to disclose green suppliers in the 10-K Business section and ESG reports, while low-ESG suppliers appear more frequently in the 10-K Risk Factors section. Strategic disclosure declines as environmental transparency regulations tighten. Finally, firms that strategically disclose green suppliers experience higher short-term stock returns, though these effects diminish over time. Our results highlight the importance of supply chain environmental disclosure and its potential to reduce capital misallocation.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了企业如何管理供应商披露以塑造更环保的供应链形象。我们发现，企业会选择性地披露与高ESG供应商的关系，同时隐瞒与低ESG供应商的联系。当供应商的环境评分从第10百分位提升至第90百分位时，披露概率相对于平均披露率增加了4.4%。我们的分析表明，这种选择性披露反映的是“漂绿”行为，而非对供应链ESG改进的真实沟通。在美国子样本中，企业更倾向于在10-K业务部分和ESG报告中披露绿色供应商，而低ESG供应商则更频繁出现在10-K风险因素部分。随着环境透明度监管的加强，战略性披露有所减少。最后，战略性披露绿色供应商的企业短期内股票回报更高，但这些效应随时间递减。我们的研究结果凸显了供应链环境披露的重要性及其在减少资本错配方面的潜在作用。

title: Ambiguity and technology adoption under index insurance: Experimental evidence
title_zh: 指数保险下的模糊性与技术采纳：实验证据
title_primary: 指数保险下的模糊性与技术采纳：实验证据
title_secondary: Ambiguity and technology adoption under index insurance: Experimental evidence
authors: Jan Jozwik
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2025-12-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: • Artefactual field experiment can precisely calibrate and vary ambiguous environment. • Ambiguity is an important factor limiting technology adoption under index insurance. • Technology take-up rates depend on the degree of ambiguity. This paper investigates the effect of ambiguity on technology adoption under index insurance. I conduct an artefactual field experiment with Ghanaian cocoa farmers. Experimental subjects had an option to invest in a package of fertilizer bundled with index insurance. The returns depended both on the subjects’ investment choices and on a stochastic weather realization. The key ingredient of the study was whether the exact probability of bad weather was known or not. This probability was ambiguous in the experimental treatments, and the degree of this ambiguity varied across treatments. A large negative effect on fertilizer investments was found in treatments with either small or large ambiguity. The effect of large ambiguity was also found to be significantly stronger, suggesting that technologies with which farmers are relatively more experienced are more likely to be adopted under index insurance schemes. I provide new evidence that ambiguity may be a significant factor limiting the effectiveness of index insurance in promoting agricultural innovation. The overall findings are complementary to related recent randomized controlled trials, since it is effectively impossible to precisely calibrate and vary the level of ambiguity using the latter methodology.
abstract_zh: 人工实地实验能够精确校准并变化模糊环境。模糊性是限制指数保险下技术采纳的重要因素。技术采纳率取决于模糊程度。本文研究了指数保险下模糊性对技术采纳的影响。我针对加纳可可种植户开展了一项人工实地实验。实验对象可选择投资于化肥与指数保险捆绑的组合。收益既取决于受试者的投资选择，也取决于随机的天气实现情况。研究的关键要素在于坏天气的确切概率是否已知。在实验处理中，该概率是模糊的，且模糊程度在不同处理间有所变化。在模糊程度较小或较大的处理中，均发现对化肥投资有显著的负面影响。同时，较大模糊性的影响显著更强，这表明农民相对更有经验的技术更可能在指数保险计划下被采纳。我提供了新证据，表明模糊性可能是限制指数保险促进农业创新有效性的重要因素。总体发现与近期相关的随机对照试验相辅相成，因为使用后一种方法实际上无法精确校准和变化模糊水平。

title: Bayesian nonparametric inference in bank business models with transient and persistent cost inefficiency
title_zh: 银行商业模式中具有瞬态和持久成本效率的贝叶斯非参数推断
title_primary: 银行商业模式中具有瞬态和持久成本效率的贝叶斯非参数推断
title_secondary: Bayesian nonparametric inference in bank business models with transient and persistent cost inefficiency
authors: Dimitris Korobilis, Emmanuel C. Mamatzakis, Vasileios Pappas
official: 官方在线 2025-10-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper introduces a novel econometric framework for identifying and modeling bank business models (BBMs), which dynamically evolve in response to changing financial and economic conditions. Building on the stochastic frontier literature, we extend the traditional cost-efficiency models by decomposing inefficiency into persistent and transient components. We propose a Bayesian nonparametric approach that adapts to the data through an infinite mixture model with predictor-dependent clustering, enabling a flexible classification of banks into distinct business models. Our method, based on the Logit Stick-Breaking Process (LSBP), provides a data-driven way to capture the heterogeneity in bank strategies, allowing for dynamic transitions between business models over time. This model offers a significant advancement over existing parametric and kernel-based approaches by combining the scalability of nonparametric methods with efficient computational routines. We apply the model to a dataset of European banks and identify four distinct business model clusters, providing novel insights into the evolution of bank performance and efficiency. Our findings contribute to the growing literature on the identification and measurement of bank business models, offering valuable implications for policy and regulatory frameworks.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的计量经济学框架，用于识别和建模银行商业模式（BBMs），这些模式随着金融和经济条件的变化而动态演变。基于随机前沿文献，我们通过将无效率分解为持久性和暂时性成分，扩展了传统的成本效率模型。我们提出了一种贝叶斯非参数方法，该方法通过具有预测变量依赖聚类的无限混合模型适应数据，从而能够灵活地将银行分类为不同的商业模式。我们的方法基于Logit Stick-Breaking过程（LSBP），提供了一种数据驱动的方式来捕捉银行策略的异质性，允许商业模式随时间动态转换。该模型通过结合非参数方法的可扩展性与高效的计算程序，相较于现有的参数化和核基方法实现了显著进步。我们将该模型应用于一组欧洲银行的数据集，识别出四个不同的商业模式集群，为银行绩效和效率的演变提供了新颖见解。我们的发现为日益增长的银行商业模式识别与测量文献做出了贡献，并为政策和监管框架提供了有价值的启示。

title: Convergent Validity of Satellite and Secchi Disk Measures of Water Clarity in Hedonic Models
title_zh: 享乐模型中卫星与塞奇盘水质透明度测量的收敛效度
title_primary: 享乐模型中卫星与塞奇盘水质透明度测量的收敛效度
title_secondary: Convergent Validity of Satellite and Secchi Disk Measures of Water Clarity in Hedonic Models
authors: Wolf, D., Kemp, T.
official: 官方在线 2021-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Budget-constrained environmental agencies across the United States are limited in their ability to monitor water quality changes using traditional in situ sampling. Satellite-based monitoring systems represent a lower-cost alternative. It is unclear, however, how this transition will impact nonmarket valuation estimates of perceived water quality. To answer this question, we merge housing information with Secchi depth and satellite estimates of water clarity from over 100 lakes in Wisconsin. A comparison of hedonic price functions reveals satellite estimates of water clarity provide a stronger statistical fit of housing price and produce implicit prices up to 11% larger in magnitude. JEL Q51Q57
abstract_zh: 美国各地受预算约束的环境机构在利用传统原位采样监测水质变化方面能力有限。基于卫星的监测系统代表了一种成本更低的替代方案。然而，这一转变将如何影响感知水质的非市场价值评估估计尚不明确。为回答此问题，我们将住房信息与威斯康星州100多个湖泊的Secchi深度及卫星估算的水体清澈度数据相结合。对特征价格函数的比较显示，卫星估算的水体清澈度对住房价格具有更强的统计拟合度，并产生幅度高达11%的隐含价格。JEL Q51Q57
